import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, "pd.DataFrame"]) -> dict[str, "pd.DataFrame"]:
    inbound = inputs["inbound"]
    target_snapshot = inputs["target_snapshot"]

    # Step 1: STG_NEW = SELECT product_id, batch_date, SUM(qty) AS total_qty,
    #                    MAX(unit_cost) AS max_unit_cost
    #          FROM inbound WHERE qty > 0 GROUP BY product_id, batch_date
    filtered = inbound[inbound["qty"] > 0]

    if filtered.empty:
        stg_new = pd.DataFrame(
            columns=["product_id", "batch_date", "total_qty", "max_unit_cost"]
        )
    else:
        grouped = (
            filtered.groupby(["product_id", "batch_date"], dropna=False)
            .agg(total_qty=("qty", "sum"), max_unit_cost=("unit_cost", "max"))
            .reset_index()
        )
        stg_new = grouped[["product_id", "batch_date", "total_qty", "max_unit_cost"]]

    # Step 2: DELETE FROM TARGET_SNAPSHOT WHERE batch_date IN
    #         (SELECT DISTINCT batch_date FROM STG_NEW)
    arriving_dates = set(stg_new["batch_date"].dropna().unique().tolist())
    has_null_date = stg_new["batch_date"].isna().any()

    if has_null_date:
        mask_delete = target_snapshot["batch_date"].isna() | target_snapshot[
            "batch_date"
        ].isin(arriving_dates)
    else:
        mask_delete = target_snapshot["batch_date"].isin(arriving_dates)

    survived = target_snapshot[~mask_delete]

    # Step 3: INSERT INTO TARGET_SNAPSHOT SELECT * FROM STG_NEW
    result = pd.concat([survived, stg_new], ignore_index=True)

    # Ensure column order matches target_snapshot's schema
    result = result[target_snapshot.columns]

    return {"target_snapshot": result}
